blocking_defects.defect: B's 'separately staged close' (limits-detail) draws the same LotPlan component, from the same straight-down viewpoint, as fleet-plan. Only the layout differs: LOT_PLAN_CLOSE scale 1.15 against LOT_PLAN 0.95, which is 1.21 times; row 1030 against 900; x0 155 against 30; the wall and oak are dropped, and the tag is size 50 against 40. Round 18 rejected a 1.1 times rescale of the same lot at phone size as 'a relabel of the same view'. A 1.21 times top-down re-layout with no change of viewpoint risks the same reading, and it does not meet pivot condition 3(b)'s 'distinct drawing at a different scale and eye height'. Fix: stage a genuinely different top-down composition. For example, one roof pod at about twice the scale or more, filling most of the frame width under the lens, with the cord and tag crossing just below it and the next roofs cropped at the edge. Or use a low oblique angle. Either must be a separate drawing, cut inside 4 s.
